title.value: GAN-based NeRF Noise Simulation in Mesh Denoising Task

abstract.value: In the present paper, we propose a new approach and a dataset for generating NeRF-like noise on the mesh surface. Our approach is based on GAN and was trained on a dataset that we collect using real NeRF noise. The core idea of our method lies in the use of graph convolutions in the generator. Our pipeline demonstrates generated NeRF-like noise more accurate than other methods by mesh denoising benchmarking. We also present a new NeRF noise analysis approach HTPH based on a conditional probability model to measure the similarity of mesh noise.
